comment:
* A typed checksum of an APK.
 *
 * @see Checksums#getChecksums

variables.name: TYPE_WHOLE_MERKLE_ROOT_4K_SHA256
variables.comment: * Root SHA256 hash of a 4K Merkle tree computed over all file bytes. * See APK Signature Scheme V4. * See fs-verity. * * Recommended for all new applications. * Can be used by kernel to enforce authenticity and integrity of the APK. * See fs-verity for details * * @see Checksums#getChecksums

variables.name: TYPE_WHOLE_MD5
variables.comment:
* MD5 hash computed over all file bytes.
     *
     * @see Checksums#getChecksums
     * @deprecated Not platform enforced. Cryptographically broken and unsuitable for further use.
     *             Use platform enforced digests e.g. {@link #TYPE_WHOLE_MERKLE_ROOT_4K_SHA256}.
     *             Provided for completeness' sake and to support legacy usecases.

variables.name: TYPE_WHOLE_SHA1
variables.comment:
* SHA1 hash computed over all file bytes.
     *
     * @see Checksums#getChecksums
     * @deprecated Not platform enforced. Broken and should not be used.
     *             Use platform enforced digests e.g. {@link #TYPE_WHOLE_MERKLE_ROOT_4K_SHA256}.
     *             Provided for completeness' sake and to support legacy usecases.

variables.name: TYPE_WHOLE_SHA256
variables.comment:
* SHA256 hash computed over all file bytes.
     * @deprecated Not platform enforced.
     *             Use platform enforced digests e.g. {@link #TYPE_WHOLE_MERKLE_ROOT_4K_SHA256}.
     *             Provided for completeness' sake and to support legacy usecases.
     *
     * @see Checksums#getChecksums

variables.name: TYPE_WHOLE_SHA512
variables.comment:
* SHA512 hash computed over all file bytes.
     * @deprecated Not platform enforced.
     *             Use platform enforced digests e.g. {@link #TYPE_WHOLE_MERKLE_ROOT_4K_SHA256}.
     *             Provided for completeness' sake and to support legacy usecases.
     *
     * @see Checksums#getChecksums

variables.name: TYPE_PARTIAL_MERKLE_ROOT_1M_SHA256
variables.comment: * Root SHA256 hash of a 1M Merkle tree computed over protected content. * Excludes signing block. * See APK Signature Scheme V2. * * @see Checksums#getChecksums

variables.name: TYPE_PARTIAL_MERKLE_ROOT_1M_SHA512
variables.comment: * Root SHA512 hash of a 1M Merkle tree computed over protected content. * Excludes signing block. * See APK Signature Scheme V2. * * @see Checksums#getChecksums

variables.name: mSplitName
variables.comment: * Checksum for which split. Null indicates base.apk.

variables.name: mInstallerPackageName
variables.comment: * For Installer-provided checksums, package name of the Installer.

variables.name: mInstallerCertificate
variables.comment: * For Installer-provided checksums, certificate of the Installer.

methods.name: public String getSplitName()
methods.comment: * Checksum for which split. Null indicates base.apk.

methods.name: public String getInstallerPackageName()
methods.comment: * For Installer-provided checksums, package name of the Installer.

methods.name: public Certificate getInstallerCertificate() throws CertificateException
methods.comment:
* For Installer-provided checksums, certificate of the Installer.
